capital_plan.source_note: Planning recommendation only. No money has been deposited, contributed or represented as company property.

permitted_activity_families: website design development maintenance and digital implementation
commercial digitalisation and international market-readiness services
CRM configuration commercial-process design and workflow automation
advertising communications commercial copywriting and non-certified localisation
commercial research market analysis and business-development support
training related to digital tools commercial processes and software use
excluded_regulated_activities: autonomous high-impact employment credit biometric emotion or sensitive-data decisions

formation_sequence.name: Record company-route decision
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Public-safe owner decision record selecting company route without personal identifiers

formation_sequence.name: Select candidate names and obtain negative name certificate
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Valid official name certificate stored in restricted custody

formation_sequence.name: Confirm registered office and actual activity location
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Address and lawful-use evidence stored in restricted custody

formation_sequence.name: Run address-specific Catalonia FUE or municipal classification
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Saved FUE result or municipal confirmation for the exact municipality, address and use

formation_sequence.name: Approve bounded corporate purpose
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Reviewed final object clause aligned with permitted services and exclusions

formation_sequence.name: Confirm CNAE and IAE classifications
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Accepted classifications recorded in official tax or formation evidence

formation_sequence.name: Confirm administrator structure, powers and remuneration
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Approved governance terms for the formation deed and tax treatment

formation_sequence.name: Confirm and document share-capital contribution
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Bank or legally accepted contribution evidence in restricted custody

formation_sequence.name: Select CIRCE/DUE or alternative notarial route
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Chosen operator route and appointment evidence

formation_sequence.name: Execute public formation deed
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Signed notarial deed in restricted custody

formation_sequence.name: Obtain provisional NIF through Modelo 036
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Official provisional NIF and Modelo 036 receipt in restricted custody

formation_sequence.name: Register the company in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Registry inscription evidence in restricted custody

formation_sequence.name: Obtain definitive NIF
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Official definitive NIF card or receipt in restricted custody

formation_sequence.name: Confirm and complete administrator Social Security route
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Professional classification and official registration receipt where required

formation_sequence.name: Configure compliant company invoicing and record retention
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Approved numbering, tax fields, SIF configuration and retention process

formation_sequence.name: Approve website identity, contracting, privacy and AI controls
formation_sequence.evidence_required: Named human approval of provider identity, contracts, privacy, processor and AI controls

restricted_custody.storage_rule: Sensitive incorporation evidence stays in restricted Drive storage and never in public source control, public comments or website artifacts.

owner_instruction.effect: Build public-safe company-formation readiness only. Do not reserve a name, incorporate, file, register, publish, collect data, contract, invoice, request payment or deliver paid work.
